arguments.new:
import re

def slugify(text: str) -> str:
    """Turn arbitrary text into a URL slug: lowercase, ASCII letters and
    digits, words separated by single hyphens, no leading/trailing hyphens."""
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace any non-alphanumeric ASCII chars with hyphens
    text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]", "-", text)
    # Collapse multiple hyphens into one
    text = re.sub(r"-+", "-", text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    return text.strip("-")

arguments.summary: Fixed slugify to collapse consecutive hyphens and strip leading/trailing hyphens. Added regex to replace -+ with single - and used strip("-") to remove edge hyphens.
